name: Rustica
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Rustica in Längenfeld**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the **Ötztal Alps**. Our cozy restaurant invites you to savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Tyrolean dumplings (Kasnudeln)**, and fresh mountain cuisine. Enjoy the warm atmosphere and stunning views of the surrounding peaks.

After your meal, explore the charming village of **Längenfeld** or take a short drive to nearby **Sölden** for world-class skiing and hiking. Whether you're here for adventure or relaxation, Rustica offers a perfect retreat in the **Tirol** countryside.

**Come and experience the best of Tyrolean culture—we look forward to welcoming you!**
